articles.description:
If you've spent any time learning about coding or software development, you've likely come across Git. This free and powerful tool has become the de facto standard for version control, used by over 90% of professional developers and many others. Git is often seen as a synonym for version control, so what exactly is a Version Control System (VCS) and why is it so crucial?
What is Git?


Git is a Distributed Version Control System (DVCS) that tracks and manages different versions of a project. A VCS, sometimes called a Source Code Management (SCM) or Revision Control System (RCS), logs changes to files or groups of files, allowing you to easily revert to earlier versions if needed. 
Version control makes it possible for multiple people to work on the same project simultaneously, regardless o…

articles.author: CP Gupta
articles.description:
How to Start Page Numbers from Page 3 in Microsoft Word: Step-by-Step Guide


Many students, educators, and professionals struggle with formatting documents in Microsoft Word. One common challenge is starting page numbers from a specific page (like page 3), while leaving the title page and table of contents unnumbered.
In this tutorial, you'll learn a step-by-step method to achieve this in Word without using any external software or plugins.
For a more detailed guide with screenshots, see:

Gupta, A. (2025). How to Start Page Numbers from Page 3 in Microsoft Word (Step-by-Step Guide). PickupBrain. Retrieved from https://www.pickupbrain.com/ms-word/start-pageno-from-page3/
Place your cursor at the end of page 2 (the page before numbering should start).

Navigate to the Layout tab → Breaks → Next Page (Section Break).
This creates a separate section, allowing different formatting for headers and footers.
Move to page 3 (where numbering should start).

Go to Insert → Page Number → select the position (top or bottom of page).

Choose your preferred numbering style.
Double-click the footer on page 3 to open the Header & Footer Tools.

Click Link to Previous to turn it off.
This ensures page numbers in the new section are independent of the previous pages.
Go to Page Number → Format Page Numbers.

Select Start at: 1.
Page 3 will now display “1,” and numbering continues sequentially for the rest of the document.
Use this method for theses, dissertations, research papers, or project reports.

If your document has multiple chapters with different numbering styles, repeat the section break method at each chapter start.

Keep your formatting consistent across sections (headers, footers, font, margins).







  
  
  References



Gupta, A. (2025). How to Start Page Numbers from Page 3 in Microsoft Word (Step-by-Step Guide). PickupBrain. Retrieved from https://www.pickupbrain.com/ms-word/start-pageno-from-page3/
articles.title: How to Start Page Numbers from Page 3 in Microsoft Word: Step-by-Step Guide

O que é um ledger?


Considere um Ledger como um "livro da verdade", por exemplo, uma planilha contábil de uma empresa, onde são registradas todas as transações que aconteceram. Assim como em uma planilha contábil, não editamos ou removemos registros, apenas adicionamos novas entradas. Isso nos garante a imutabilidade, que é um ótimo princípio em sistemas financeiros. A forma mais comum de tratar isso é por meio de eventos de entrada e saída, junto ao montante de valor correspondente para cada transação.
Como fazer?


Primeiramente, é uma prática essencial manter um Ledger distinto para cada tipo de moeda, como BRL ou USD, para simplificar radicalmente a lógica de negócio e os cálculos. Além disso, para prevenir o processamento duplicado em um sistema distribuído, cada operação deve ser ac…
articles.title: Como implementar um Ledger em sístemas distribuídos
